brain_note: Talmy 1988 / Wolff 2007 force dynamics is domain-general (physical/psychological/social); the CAUSE/ENABLE/PREVENT typology is one engine, the force-SOURCE extraction is domain-specific (intuitive-physics ToBY vs mentalizing ToMM, two brain systems). This cell adds the intentional source; the typer is UNCHANGED. Commitment-to-act vs commitment-to-refrain is the intentional tendency-ambiguity (the same world-knowledge bound as physical CAUSE-vs-ENABLE).
